name: Maggi Atta Noodles
ingredients_raw: Noodles: Resultant Wheat Flour (Resultant Atta) (84.2%), Palm oil, lodized salt, Wheat gluten, Thickeners (508 & 412), Humectants (451 (i) & 452(i)) and Acidity regulators (501 (i) & 500 (i)). Tastemaker : Mixed spices (22.5%) (Roasted spice mix powder (6.6%) (Coriander, Turmeric, Cumin, Aniseed, Black pepper, Fenugreek, Ginger, Green cardamom, Cinnamon, Clove, Nutmeg, Bay leaf, Black cardamom), Onion powder, Garlic powder, Red chilli powder, Red chilli bits Coriander powder, Turmeric powder, Ginger powder, Aniseed powder, Black pepper powder Cumin powder, Cumin, Fenugreek powder, Capsicum extract, Compounded asafoetida, Star Anise powder, Coriander extract & Cumin extract), Dehydrated Vegetables (16.7%) (Carrot bits 18.5%), Green peas (8.2%)), Toasted onion flakes (Onion (12.4%), Corn oil), Resultant Weat Flour (Resultant Atta), Sugar, lodized salt, Toasted onion powder (Onion (5.9%), Corn oil) Thickener (508), Palm oil, Flavour enhancer (635), Yeast extract powder, Starch, Dehydrated casuri methi leaves, Acidity regulator (330), Wheat gluten and Mineral. Contains Wheat. May contains Milk, Oats and Soy.
